title: Sapphire
body:
Description

Sapphire is a new ore found in Darkslate in the caves under the Snowlands. It looks similar to Boomite in that it has large dark blue crystal-like shapes protruding from the rocks surface.

When refined, sapphire takes on a slight translucent appearance, allowing a player to see through it. When forged, the sapphire ingot takes on a foil-like texture while still staying translucent.

Sapphire is most commonly found near the entrance to the Ice Golem Shop or underneath Giant Ice Crystals, which can be destroyed by use of a Flamethrower or an explosive or use of a Icethrower.

Sapphire's price (though not listed in resource hub yet) is $200/stud refined, and $320/stud forged.
